title: Create independent inventory objects using classes
goal: Initialize the instance state in the constructor, update and read the state through methods.
summary: Two training rooms track spare supplies separately. Each inventory object has its own quantity and restocking method.
tasks: Complete constructor(initial), receive(count), and total() in the SupplyBox class.
Each call to receive adds to the instance's quantity. total returns its current quantity. Keep runBoxes to preview the results for both boxes.

example.note: new creates an instance and calls its constructor. Methods can access the current instance through this.

hint: Store the quantity on this so each object has its own value. receive adds to the existing quantity.
